SELECT
  period,
  SUM(qty * unit_price_orig) AS total_usd,
  SUM(amount_cad) AS total_cad,
  AVG(fx_rate) AS avg_fx_rate,
  SUM(qty) AS total_qty
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE currency = 'USD' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period
